test_cases.title: Start of Mission tetikleyicisi ile oturum kurulumu
test_cases.preconditions: OBU Level 2 modunda yapılandırılmıştır. RBC erişilebilir durumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Start of Mission komutu.

steps.action: Sürücü Start of Mission prosedürünü başlatır.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma sürecini başlatır (güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu isteği gönderilir).

steps.action: RBC'den gelen sistem sürümü mesajı beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, oturumun kurulduğunu kabul eder ve 'session established report' mesajını RBC'ye gönderir.

test_cases.title: Radyo deliğinin sonuna varışta oturum kurulumu
test_cases.preconditions: Tren, bildirilmiş bir radyo deliğinden geçmektedir. OBU Level 2'dedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trenin arka ucunun radyo deliğinin sonuna ulaşması.

steps.action: Trenin motor arka ucu, bildirilmiş radyo deliğinin son noktasına ulaşır.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile yeni bir iletişim oturumu kurma sürecini başlatır.

steps.action: RBC'den gelen sistem sürümü mesajı beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, oturumun kurulduğunu kabul eder ve 'session established report' mesajını RBC'ye gönderir.

test_cases.title: Manuel Level 2 değişiminde oturum kurulumu
test_cases.preconditions: OBU Level 1 veya başka bir seviyededir. RBC erişilebilir durumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sürücünün seviyeyi manuel olarak 2'ye değiştirmesi.

steps.action: Sürücü, OBU'da çalışma seviyesini manuel olarak Level 2'ye değiştirir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma sürecini başlatır.

steps.action: RBC'den gelen sistem sürümü mesajı beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, oturumun kurulduğunu kabul eder ve 'session established report' mesajını RBC'ye gönderir.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kaybı sonrası oturum kurulumu
test_cases.preconditions: Aktif bir iletişim oturumu vardır. RBC ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kesilir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Güvenli radyo bağlantısının kaybı.

steps.action: RBC ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kesilir ve mevcut oturum sonlandırılmış olarak kabul edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni bir iletişim oturumu kurma sürecini başlatır.

steps.action: RBC'den gelen sistem sürümü mesajı beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, oturumun kurulduğunu kabul eder ve 'session established report' mesajını RBC'ye gönderir.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulum sıralaması ve hata yönetimi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma tetikleyicisi almıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen sistem sürümü mesajı.

steps.action: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu isteğini gönderir.
steps.expected: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulur.

steps.action: OBU, 'Initiation of communication session' mesajını gönderir.
steps.expected: RBC'den sistem sürümü mesajı alınır.

steps.action: Alınan sistem sürümü ile uyumluluk kontrolü yapılır.
steps.expected: Sürüm uyumlu olduğundan, OBU oturumu kurulu kabul eder ve 'session established report' gönderir.

test_cases.title: Uyumsuz sistem sürümü durumunda oturum sonlandırma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma tetikleyicisi almıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen uyumsuz sistem sürümü mesajı.

steps.action: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu isteğini gönderir ve 'Initiation of communication session' mesajını iletir.
steps.expected: RBC'den sistem sürümü mesajı alınır.

steps.action: Alınan sistem sürümü ile uyumluluk kontrolü yapılır.
steps.expected: Sürüm uyumsuz olduğundan, OBU 'No compatible version supported' mesajını gönderir.

steps.action: Sürücüye bilgi verilmesi ve oturumun sonlandırılması beklenir.
steps.expected: Sürücüye uyumsuz sürüm hatası bildirilir ve iletişim oturumu sonlandırılır.

test_cases.title: Radyo sistemi seçimi: Trackside emri önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem FRMCS hem GSM-R radyo sistemleri mevcuttur. RBC, FRMCS ile arayüze sahiptir.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen iletişim oturumu kurma emri.

steps.action: RBC'den gelen emir, FRMCS ile arayüze sahip bir RBC'ye yöneliktir.
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu isteğini FRMCS radyo sistemi üzerinden gönderir.

test_cases.title: Radyo sistemi seçimi: Sürücü tercihi önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem FRMCS hem GSM-R radyo sistemleri mevcuttur. Kayıtlı Radio Network type: FRMCS+GSM-R. Start of Mission sırasında sürücü tek radyo sistemi (GSM-R) seçmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: İletişim oturumu kurma tetikleyicisi.

steps.action: İletişim oturumu kurma süreci başlatılır.
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu isteğini GSM-R radyo sistemi üzerinden gönderir.

test_cases.title: Radyo sistemi seçimi: Kayıtlı bilgi ve tercih edilen sistem
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem FRMCS hem GSM-R radyo sistemleri mevcuttur. Kayıtlı Radio Network type: FRMCS+GSM-R. Önceki oturumda FRMCS kullanılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: İletişim oturumu kurma tetikleyicisi.

steps.action: İletişim oturumu kurma süreci başlatılır.
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu isteğini FRMCS radyo sistemi üzerinden gönderir (önceki oturumda tercih edilen sistem).

test_cases.title: Başarılı radyo sisteminin hafızaya alınması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem FRMCS hem GSM-R radyo sistemleri mevcuttur. GSM-R üzerinden güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulur.
test_cases.test_inputs: GSM-R üzerinden başarılı bağlantı kurulumu.

steps.action: GSM-R radyo sistemi üzerinden güvenli radyo bağlantısı başarıyla kurulur.
steps.expected: OBU, başarılı bağlantı için kullanılan radyo sistemini (GSM-R) hafızasına kaydeder.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu sırasında End of Mission ile sonlandırma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma sürecindedir (güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulmuş, sistem sürümü bekleniyor).
test_cases.test_inputs: End of Mission komutu.

steps.action: Sürücü End of Mission prosedürünü başlatır.
steps.expected: OBU, devam eden oturum kurulumunu sonlandırır ve güvenli radyo bağlantısını (varsa) serbest bırakır.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu sırasında RBC/RBC sınır geçişi ile sonlandırma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma sürecindedir. Tren, RBC/RBC sınırına yaklaşıyor.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trenin min safe rear end'inin RBC/RBC sınırını geçmesi.

steps.action: Trenin min safe rear end'i, RBC/RBC sınırını geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, devam eden oturum kurulumunu sonlandırır ve güvenli radyo bağlantısını (varsa) serbest bırakır.

test_cases.title: Son bilinen RBC emri ile oturum kurulumu
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da RBC iletişim bilgileri kayıtlıdır. RBC'den 'son bilinen RBC' emri alınır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen 'son bilinen RBC' emri.

steps.action: RBC'den gelen emir, 'son bilinen RBC' özel kimlik değerini içerir.
steps.expected: OBU, emirde verilen telefon numarasını yok sayar ve kayıtlı RBC iletişim bilgilerini kullanarak RBC'ye bağılır.

test_cases.title: Kayıtlı RBC bilgisi yokken 'son bilinen RBC' emrinin yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da RBC iletişim bilgileri kayıtlı değildir. RBC'den 'son bilinen RBC' emri alınır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen 'son bilinen RBC' emri.

steps.action: RBC'den gelen emir, 'son bilinen RBC' özel kimlik değerini içerir.
steps.expected: OBU, emri yok sayar ve iletişim oturumu kurma işlemi başlatmaz.

test_cases.title: OBU does not open a second session with the same RBC while the first is being established
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A session establishment process with RBC-A is in progress (e.g., GSM-R connection setup initiated).
test_cases.test_inputs: A second trigger to establish a session with RBC-A (e.g., driver selects 'Start' again or a trackside order is received).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs session establishment attempts and status.

steps.action: Initiate the first session establishment with RBC-A.
steps.expected: The OBU begins the session establishment process with RBC-A.

steps.action: While the first session is still being established, trigger a second session establishment request with the same RBC-A.
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate a new, separate session establishment process with RBC-A. The existing process continues or is handled according to internal logic without creating a duplicate concurrent session.

test_cases.title: OBU does not open a second session with the same RBC while the first is established
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has an established communication session with RBC-A. No Termination of Communication Session message has been sent to RBC-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trigger to establish a session with RBC-A (e.g., manual level change to Level 2 or driver selects RBC contact info).

steps.action: Verify the session with RBC-A is active and stable.
steps.expected: The OBU status indicates an active session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Trigger a new session establishment request with RBC-A.
steps.expected: The OBU does not attempt to open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session remains active.

test_cases.title: OBU terminates existing session with RBC-A to establish session with RBC-B
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has an established communication session with RBC-A. The OBU is capable of handling only one GSM-R session at a time (or the new order requires it).
test_cases.test_inputs: An order from trackside to establish a session with RBC-B (not an Accepting RBC embedded in a transition order that preserves the old session).
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-B is reachable and ready to accept the session.

steps.action: Receive an order to establish a communication session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the existing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Wait for the termination of the session with RBC-A to complete.
steps.expected: The session with RBC-A is terminated.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action towards RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU establishes a new communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: OBU maintains existing session with Supervising RBC when receiving order for Accepting RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has an established communication session with RBC-A (Supervising RBC). The OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions or the specific exception applies.
test_cases.test_inputs: An RBC transition order containing an embedded order to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is configured to support the exception where the session with the supervising RBC is not terminated immediately upon receiving the Accepting RBC order.

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order that includes an order to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
steps.expected: The OBU does not terminate the existing session with RBC-A immediately.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's session status.
steps.expected: The session with RBC-A remains active while the OBU processes the transition to RBC-B.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates balise information validity based on crossing direction in Sleeping mode
test_cases.preconditions: The engine is in Sleeping (SL) mode. The train is moving in the reverse direction relative to the nominal track direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group containing information valid only for the reverse direction (the direction of travel).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can be set to SL mode and the train can be moved in reverse.

steps.action: Set the OBU to Sleeping (SL) mode.
steps.expected: The OBU status indicates SL mode.

steps.action: Move the train in the reverse direction over a balise group that contains information valid only for the reverse direction.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account, as it is valid for the crossing direction.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores balise information valid only for the opposite direction in Shunting mode
test_cases.preconditions: The engine is in Shunting (SH) mode. The train is moving in the nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group containing information valid only for the reverse direction (opposite to the direction of travel).

steps.action: Set the OBU to Shunting (SH) mode.
steps.expected: The OBU status indicates SH mode.

steps.action: Move the train in the nominal direction over a balise group that contains information valid only for the reverse direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information, as it is valid only for the opposite direction.

test_cases.title: OBU keeps applying last received MA request parameters until new ones are received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 and has received MA request parameters from RBC (e.g., repetition period = 10s).
test_cases.test_inputs: No new MA request parameters are received from the RBC.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs the MA request parameters and the timing of MA requests.

steps.action: Wait for a period longer than the defined repetition period without receiving new parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to use the previously received MA request parameters for any MA requests triggered.

steps.action: Trigger an MA request condition (e.g., time before section timer expires).
steps.expected: The OBU sends the MA request using the old parameters (e.g., if repetition was required, it follows the old interval logic).

test_cases.title: OBU sends MA request immediately if time since last request exceeds new repetition period
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. The last MA request was sent 15 seconds ago. The current MA request parameters have a repetition period of 10 seconds.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC with a repetition period of 5 seconds.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate the reception of new parameters at a specific time.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC with a repetition period of 5 seconds.
steps.expected: The OBU updates its internal MA request parameters to the new values.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action immediately after receiving the new parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request immediately, because the time since the last MA request (15s) is higher than the newly received repetition period (5s).

test_cases.title: OBU does not define SvL while supervising a Limit of Authority
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a Movement Authority that includes a Limit of Authority (LOA) with a target speed above zero.
test_cases.test_inputs: Track data that would normally define a Supervised Location (SvL) such as an end of overlap or Danger Point within the LOA.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can display or log the current SvL status.

steps.action: Configure the OBU to supervise an MA with a LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU is supervising the LOA.

steps.action: Check the OBU's Supervised Location (SvL) status while the LOA is active.
steps.expected: The OBU does not define any SvL on board. No SvL candidate (end of overlap, Danger Point, end of End Section) is used as SvL.

test_cases.title: Level 1 signalling speed restriction remains valid until new restriction received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h has been received and is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: No new signalling related speed restriction is received for a period of time.

steps.action: Verify the active speed restriction is 80 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the 80 km/h speed restriction.

steps.action: Wait for a period without receiving a new signalling related speed restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply the 80 km/h speed restriction.

test_cases.title: Level 1 signalling speed restriction remains valid after switching to Level 2 until Level 2 MA accepted
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 with an active signalling related speed restriction of 60 km/h. The train is approaching a Level 2 area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Transition to Level 2. A Level 2 MA is not yet accepted.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can switch levels and the Level 2 MA acceptance can be delayed or observed.

steps.action: Switch the OBU from Level 1 to Level 2.
steps.expected: The OBU is now in Level 2 mode.

steps.action: Check the speed restriction status before a Level 2 MA is accepted.
steps.expected: The Level 1 signalling related speed restriction (60 km/h) remains valid and is applied by the OBU.

steps.action: Accept a Level 2 MA.
steps.expected: The Level 1 signalling related speed restriction is no longer the primary constraint (replaced by Level 2 MA logic).

test_cases.title: OBU handles Maximum Train Speed as a Static Speed Restriction category
test_cases.preconditions: The train's actual performance and configuration allow a maximum speed of 200 km/h.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train data configuration with Maximum Train Speed set to 200 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can display the applied speed limits and their sources.

steps.action: Configure the OBU with a Maximum Train Speed of 200 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the configuration.

steps.action: Check how the OBU treats the 200 km/h value in its speed restriction logic.
steps.expected: The OBU handles the 200 km/h value as the Maximum Train Speed category of Static Speed Restriction.

test_cases.title: OBU uses 'no speed restriction' as initial state for permitted braking distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where no speed restriction has been computed from trackside data (e.g., just after power-up or after a reset).
test_cases.test_inputs: No trackside speed restriction data received.

steps.action: Start the OBU in a state where no speed restriction data is available.
steps.expected: The OBU initializes the speed restriction state to 'no speed restriction'.

steps.action: Check the permitted braking distance limit applied to the train speed.
steps.expected: No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed due to speed restrictions.

test_cases.title: OBU resumes 'no speed restriction' state when ordered by trackside
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is currently applying a speed restriction (e.g., 100 km/h) based on trackside data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to resume the initial state (no speed restriction).

steps.action: Verify the OBU is applying a speed restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU is limiting the train speed according to the active restriction.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to resume the initial state for speed restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU clears the active speed restriction.

steps.action: Check the permitted braking distance limit.
steps.expected: No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed due to speed restrictions.

test_cases.title: Immediate reconnection attempt upon radio loss
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The OBU is connected via GSM-R (or the active radio system). EURORADIO is monitoring the connection.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection signal from EURORADIO.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'defined time' for session termination is sufficiently long to allow observation of the immediate attempt.

steps.action: Trigger a loss of the safe radio connection via EURORADIO simulation.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately initiates a request to set up a new safe radio connection using the same radio system previously used.

steps.action: Allow the new safe radio connection to be established successfully.
steps.expected: The OBU sends the 'Initiation of communication session' message to the trackside.

test_cases.title: Repeated reconnection attempts until success
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated failure of the first reconnection attempt, followed by a successful second attempt.
test_cases.assumptions: The session termination timer has not expired.

steps.action: Trigger loss of safe radio connection.
steps.expected: OBU attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate failure of the first reconnection attempt.
steps.expected: OBU immediately repeats the attempt to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate success of the second reconnection attempt.
steps.expected: OBU stops repeating attempts and proceeds to establish the communication session (sends Initiation of communication session).

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when session is terminated by timeout
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated persistent failure of reconnection attempts exceeding the defined time limit.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined time for session termination is known and can be simulated or waited out.

steps.action: Trigger loss of safe radio connection.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating reconnection attempts.

steps.action: Simulate continuous failure of reconnection attempts until the defined time expires.
steps.expected: OBU considers the session as terminated and stops the reconnection attempts.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The safe radio connection is lost. An RIU order to terminate the communication session at a specific location is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of connection, train movement past the specified location.
test_cases.assumptions: The train position is accurately tracked by the OBU.

steps.action: Trigger loss of safe radio connection.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating reconnection attempts.

steps.action: Move the train past the location indicated in the RIU order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: OBU stops the reconnection attempts as the session is considered terminated due to passing the location.

test_cases.title: Termination initiated by trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established between the OBU and the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: A 'Termination of communication session' order message from the RBC.

steps.action: Send a 'Termination of communication session' order from the RBC to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination procedure by sending a 'Termination of communication session' message to the RBC.

test_cases.title: No termination initiated without valid condition
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. No trackside order is received and no internal termination condition is met.

steps.action: Wait for a duration longer than the fixed waiting time without sending any trackside order or triggering internal conditions.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send a 'Termination of communication session' message and the session remains active.

test_cases.title: Repetition of termination message upon missing acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has initiated session termination and sent the first 'Termination of communication session' message. The RBC does not send an acknowledgement.
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time is T_wait and the defined number of repetitions is N_rep (N_rep > 1).

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time T_wait after the first message without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU sends the 'Termination of communication session' message again (1st repetition).

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time T_wait after the 1st repetition without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU sends the 'Termination of communication session' message again (2nd repetition).

test_cases.title: Session considered terminated after max repetitions
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the process of terminating a session. It has already sent the initial message and repeated it (N_rep - 1) times without acknowledgement.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions is N_rep. The fixed waiting time is T_wait.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time T_wait after the (N_rep - 1)-th repetition without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU sends the 'Termination of communication session' message for the N_rep-th time (last allowed repetition).

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time T_wait after the N_rep-th sending without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session terminated and stops sending further termination messages.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobile Terminal registration at power-up
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered off. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected and powered on. The OBU has a valid GSM-R Radio Network identity stored or default configured.

steps.action: Power on the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the registration process for the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the GSM-R Radio Network.

steps.action: Monitor the GSM-R Mobile Terminal status.
steps.expected: The GSM-R Mobile Terminal becomes registered to the GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobile Terminal registration after driver enters new identity
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and operational. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected. The current GSM-R Radio Network identity is different from the one to be entered.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new valid GSM-R Radio Network identity.

steps.action: Driver enters a new GSM-R Radio Network identity into the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new identity.

steps.action: Observe the OBU behavior regarding the GSM-R Mobile Terminal.
steps.expected: The OBU orders the registration of the GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the newly entered GSM-R Radio Network.

steps.action: Monitor the GSM-R Mobile Terminal status.
steps.expected: The GSM-R Mobile Terminal becomes registered to the new GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobile Terminal registration when ordered by trackside
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and operational. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected but not registered to the target network. The trackside sends a Radio Network transition order specifying a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside Radio Network transition order containing a GSM-R Radio Network type.

steps.action: Receive a Radio Network transition order from trackside specifying a GSM-R Radio Network.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the Radio Network type.

steps.action: Observe the OBU behavior regarding the GSM-R Mobile Terminal.
steps.expected: The OBU orders the registration of the GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the specified GSM-R Radio Network.

steps.action: Monitor the GSM-R Mobile Terminal status.
steps.expected: The GSM-R Mobile Terminal becomes registered to the specified GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: Use of default Radio Network type after System Failure
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. A System Failure occurs causing the loss of memorised Radio Network type. The OBU is restarted.
test_cases.assumptions: The default Radio Network type is configured on-board.

steps.action: Induce a System Failure that clears the memorised Radio Network type.
steps.expected: The OBU loses the memorised Radio Network type.

steps.action: Restart the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initializes.

steps.action: Check the Radio Network type used by the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the default Radio Network type configured on-board.

test_cases.title: Use of default Radio Network type at very first power-up
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a factory-fresh state with no memorised Radio Network type. The OBU is powered off.
test_cases.assumptions: The default Radio Network type is configured on-board.

steps.action: Power on the OBU for the very first time.
steps.expected: The OBU initializes.

steps.action: Check the Radio Network type used by the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the default Radio Network type configured on-board.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when FRMCS not registered (FRMCS only installed)

test_cases.title: OBU ignores information valid for the opposite direction
test_cases.preconditions: The train is moving in the nominal direction. The OBU is in a state where it processes trackside information.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside message (e.g., balise or radio) containing valid data for the reverse direction only.

steps.action: Transmit a message from a trackside device that is valid only for the reverse direction while the train is oriented in the nominal direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the received information and does not update its internal state or apply the data.

test_cases.title: OBU accepts information valid for the current train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: The train is moving in the nominal direction. The OBU is in a state where it processes trackside information.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside message containing valid data for the nominal direction.

steps.action: Transmit a message from a trackside device that is valid only for the nominal direction while the train is oriented in the nominal direction.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account and updates its internal state accordingly.

test_cases.title: OBU rejects one-direction data when orientation cannot be related to trackside direction
test_cases.preconditions: The train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., no coordinate system assigned to the balise group).
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside message valid for one direction only (nominal or reverse).

steps.action: Transmit a message from a trackside device that is valid for one direction only while the train orientation cannot be related to the device's direction.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data and does not apply it.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates data valid for both directions when orientation cannot be related

test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside message valid for both directions.

steps.action: Transmit a message from a trackside device that is valid for both directions while the train orientation cannot be related to the device's direction.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the data and applies it to its internal state.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data: Value n applies over distance n+1

steps.action: Transmit continuous profile data where value(1) is followed by distance(2).
steps.expected: The OBU applies value(1) for the distance defined by distance(2).

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data: Previously received data applies over the first distance
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has previously received continuous profile data with a known value.

steps.action: Transmit continuous profile data where the first element is distance(1) without a preceding value in the new message.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the previously received data for the distance defined by distance(1).

steps.expected: The OBU applies the last value for an unlimited distance beyond the last defined distance.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data: Value followed by zero distance is taken into account

test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data set where distance(n+1) is 0.

steps.action: Transmit continuous profile data where a value is followed by a distance of 0.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the corresponding profile value into account.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking consistency is checked.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information containing location accuracy for Balise Group A. Balise Group A is received.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking information provides a valid location accuracy value (e.g., 10m).

steps.action: Receive linking information that specifies the location accuracy for Balise Group A.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the location accuracy from the linking information for Balise Group A.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group A such that it becomes the LRBG or ORBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the location accuracy previously determined from the linking information for Balise Group A.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from National Value when linking is unavailable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. No linking information has determined the location accuracy for Balise Group B. A National Value for location accuracy is applicable.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise Group B is received and becomes LRBG or ORBG.
test_cases.assumptions: The applicable National Value for location accuracy is 15m.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group B such that it becomes the LRBG or ORBG without prior linking information determining its accuracy.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the applicable National Value (15m) as the location accuracy for Balise Group B.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from Default Value when no National Value applies
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. No linking information has determined the location accuracy for Balise Group C. No National Value is applicable.

steps.expected: The OBU uses the Default Value (20m) as the location accuracy for Balise Group C.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated upon further linking information
test_cases.preconditions: The location accuracy of Balise Group D has been determined (e.g., 10m) and it is currently the LRBG or ORBG.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information is received that implies a different location accuracy for Balise Group D.
test_cases.assumptions: The new linking information suggests a location accuracy of 12m for Balise Group D.

steps.action: Receive new linking information that would imply a different location accuracy for Balise Group D.
steps.expected: The OBU does not update the location accuracy of Balise Group D; it remains at the previously determined value (10m).

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated when linking is no longer checked
test_cases.preconditions: The location accuracy of Balise Group E has been determined (e.g., 10m). Linking consistency is currently checked.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking consistency checking is disabled.

steps.action: Disable linking consistency checking.
steps.expected: The OBU does not update the location accuracy of Balise Group E; it remains at the previously determined value (10m).

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated when new National Values become applicable

test_cases.assumptions: The new National Value is 15m.

steps.action: Apply a new National Value for location accuracy.
steps.expected: The OBU does not update the location accuracy of Balise Group F; it remains at the previously determined value (10m).

test_cases.title: Confidence interval delimitation with min and max safe front ends
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. The estimated front end position is known. The location accuracy of the reference balise group is known. Over-reading and under-reading amounts are known. No consist-length-related situation applies.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated front end position: 1000m. Location accuracy: 10m. Over-reading: 5m. Under-reading: 5m.
test_cases.assumptions: The confidence interval is calculated as estimated position +/- (location accuracy + over/under-reading).

steps.action: Calculate the min safe front end position.
steps.expected: The min safe front end is located in rear of the estimated front end at a distance of 10m (location accuracy) + 5m (under-reading) = 15m. Min safe front end = 1000m - 15m = 985m.

steps.action: Calculate the max safe front end position.
steps.expected: The max safe front end is located in advance of the estimated front end at a distance of 10m (location accuracy) + 5m (over-reading) = 15m. Max safe front end = 1000m + 15m = 1015m.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. Balise Group G is the most recently received balise group that is the reference of linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise Group G is received.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group G which is the reference of linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU sets Balise Group G as the Single On-board Location Reference (SOLR).

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is not checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is not checked. Balise Group H is the last received balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise Group H is received.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group H.
steps.expected: The OBU sets Balise Group H as the Single On-board Location Reference (SOLR).

test_cases.title: Linking replacement rule applied before SOLR update
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking information is received that triggers a SOLR update.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information that changes the SOLR.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking replacement rule (SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1 m)) is defined and applicable.

steps.action: Receive linking information that requires a SOLR update.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the linking replacement rule before updating the SOLR.

test_cases.title: Relocation before replacement rule for non-linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Location based information referred to a balise group other than the SOLR is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location based information referred to a non-SOLR balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The corresponding replacement rule of §3.7.3.1 is defined and applicable.

steps.action: Receive location based information referred to a balise group other than the SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the information to the SOLR before applying the corresponding replacement rule of §3.7.3.1.

test_cases.title: Processing location based information into min, estimated, and max items
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Location based information is received that requires processing into location items.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location based information with min, estimated, and max values.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 Table 2a associates clauses with location item types for this information.

steps.action: Receive location based information that can be processed into min, estimated, and max location items.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the information into up to three location items: 'min', 'estimated', and 'max'.

steps.action: Apply the clause associated with the 'min' location item type.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the 'min' location item for the corresponding clause.

steps.action: Apply the clause associated with the 'estimated' location item type.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the 'estimated' location item for the corresponding clause.

steps.action: Apply the clause associated with the 'max' location item type.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the 'max' location item for the corresponding clause.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items to SOLR using linking information
test_cases.preconditions: A balise group becomes the SOLR. Location based information referred to a former reference balise group (FRBG) is available. Linking information between FRBG and SOLR is available and known.
test_cases.test_inputs: Distance from FRBG to location item: 100m. Distance between FRBG and SOLR from linking information: 50m. Location item type: 'estimated'.
test_cases.assumptions: The last relocation of this location item was not performed as per clause 3.6.4.2.5 c).

steps.action: Relocate the 'estimated' location item to the SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU subtracts the distance between FRBG and SOLR (50m) from the distance to the FRBG (100m). New distance to SOLR = 100m - 50m = 50m.

test_cases.title: Relocation of 'min' location item with location accuracy adjustment
test_cases.preconditions: A balise group becomes the SOLR. Location based information referred to a former reference balise group (FRBG) is available. The last relocation of this location item was performed as per clause 3.6.4.2.5 c) towards a BG not received earlier than the reference BG. Linking information between FRBG and SOLR is available and known.
test_cases.test_inputs: Distance from FRBG to 'min' location item: 100m. Distance between FRBG and SOLR from linking information: 50m. Location accuracy of FRBG: 10m.

steps.action: Relocate the 'min' location item to the SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU subtracts the distance between FRBG and SOLR (50m) diminished by twice the location accuracy of FRBG (2 * 10m = 20m) from the distance to the FRBG (100m). New distance to SOLR = 100m - (50m - 20m) = 100m - 30m = 70m.

test_cases.title: Relocation of 'max' location item with location accuracy adjustment
test_cases.preconditions: A balise group becomes the SOLR. Location based information referred to a former reference balise group (FRBG) is available. The last relocation of this location item was performed as per clause 3.6.4.2.5 c) towards a BG not received earlier than the reference BG. Linking information between FRBG and SOLR is available and known.
test_cases.test_inputs: Distance from FRBG to 'max' location item: 100m. Distance between FRBG and SOLR from linking information: 50m. Location accuracy of FRBG: 10m.

steps.action: Relocate the 'max' location item to the SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU subtracts the distance between FRBG and SOLR (50m) augmented by twice the location accuracy of FRBG (2 * 10m = 20m) from the distance to the FRBG (100m). New distance to SOLR = 100m - (50m + 20m) = 100m - 70m = 30m.

test_cases.title: Relocation using travelled distance when linking information is not available
test_cases.preconditions: A balise group becomes the SOLR. Location based information referred to a former reference balise group (FRBG) is available. Linking information between FRBG and SOLR is not available or not known.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated front end position against FRBG: 100m. Estimated front end position against SOLR: 50m. Location item type: 'estimated'.
test_cases.assumptions: The travelled distance is computed as per clauses 3.6.1.3 and 3.6.4.1.5.

steps.action: Relocate the 'estimated' location item to the SOLR using travelled distance.
steps.expected: The OBU computes the distance between FRBG and SOLR as (estimated front end position against FRBG - estimated front end position against SOLR) = 100m - 50m = 50m. The location item is relocated by subtracting this distance from its distance to the FRBG.

test_cases.title: Geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where geographical position information is available and valid. The geographical position display is currently inactive.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver request to display geographical position.

steps.action: Verify that the geographical position is not displayed on the HMI.
steps.expected: The geographical position is not visible on the driver display.

steps.action: The driver issues a request to display the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the geographical position of the estimated front end of the train in relation to the track kilometre.

test_cases.title: Stop geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The geographical position is currently being displayed on the HMI.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver request to stop displaying geographical position.

steps.action: Verify that the geographical position is currently displayed.
steps.expected: The geographical position is visible on the driver display.

steps.action: The driver issues a request to stop the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the geographical position.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation includes distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has detected a geographical reference balise group and has stored the associated track kilometre reference and offset. The train is moving in the direction of the track kilometre counting.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement data (odometer) indicating a specific distance travelled from the reference balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The track kilometre counting direction is consistent with the train's movement direction for this test.

steps.action: Record the track kilometre reference value (TK_ref) and the offset (Offset) from the stored geographical position information.
steps.expected: TK_ref and Offset are correctly retrieved from the OBU's stored data.

steps.action: Move the train a known distance (D_travelled) from the geographical reference balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the estimated distance travelled.

steps.action: Request the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The displayed geographical position is equal to TK_ref + Offset + D_travelled (assuming counting direction is positive). This confirms that the distance travelled since the reference location is added to the calculation.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation with negative counting direction
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has detected a geographical reference balise group. The track kilometre counting direction is opposite to the train's movement direction (counting down).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement data indicating a distance travelled (D_travelled) in the direction opposite to the track kilometre increment.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'counting direction' parameter in the geographical position information is set to indicate a negative relationship relative to the train's forward movement.

steps.action: Record the track kilometre reference value (TK_ref) and the offset (Offset).
steps.expected: TK_ref and Offset are correctly retrieved.

steps.action: Move the train a known distance (D_travelled) from the geographical reference balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the estimated distance travelled.

steps.action: Request the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The displayed geographical position is equal to TK_ref + Offset - D_travelled. This confirms that the distance travelled is accounted for correctly according to the counting direction.

test_cases.title: Roll-away distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where Roll Away Protection supervision can be started (e.g., Standstill). The train is not aligned with a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: National Value for Roll Away distance: 10 m. Initial estimated position: 0 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the calculated remaining distance for test observation.

steps.action: Move the train 3 m away from the start location in the supervised direction.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 7 m (10 m - 3 m).

test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Post Trip mode. The train is not aligned with a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: National Value for reversing distance: 5 m. Initial estimated position: 0 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the calculated remaining distance for test observation.

steps.action: Start the supervision for reversing in Post Trip mode.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be 5 m.

steps.action: Move the train 2 m in the reversing direction.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 3 m.

test_cases.title: Staff Responsible distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Staff Responsible mode. The train is not aligned with a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: SR distance set by RBC: 100 m. Initial estimated position: 0 m. Odometer error: 0 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the virtual train front position and remaining distance for test observation.

steps.action: Start the Staff Responsible distance supervision.

steps.action: Move the train 10 m away from the start location.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance from the estimated front end to 90 m (100 m - 10 m).

test_cases.title: Standstill supervision with odometer under-reading
test_cases.preconditions: Standstill supervision is active. The train is not aligned with a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised distance: 10 m. Odometer under-reading amount: 2 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows simulation of odometer under-reading for test purposes.

steps.action: Start the Standstill supervision at position 0 m.
steps.expected: The OBU initializes the supervision with a remaining distance of 10 m.

steps.action: Move the train 5 m away from the start location.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the max safe front end position as 3 m (10 m - 5 m - 2 m).

test_cases.title: SR distance supervision with odometer over-reading
test_cases.preconditions: Staff Responsible mode is active. The train is not aligned with a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: SR distance: 50 m. Odometer over-reading amount: 5 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows simulation of odometer over-reading for test purposes.

steps.action: Start the SR distance supervision at position 0 m.
steps.expected: The OBU initializes the virtual train position.

steps.action: Move the train 10 m away from the start location.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the min safe front end position as 45 m (50 m - 10 m + 5 m).

test_cases.title: SR distance supervision restart upon RBC update
test_cases.preconditions: Staff Responsible mode is active. SR supervision is already running with a virtual position.
test_cases.test_inputs: Initial SR distance: 100 m. New SR distance from RBC: 200 m. Current travelled distance: 10 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the virtual train position and remaining distance for test observation.

steps.action: Start SR supervision with 100 m distance and move 10 m.
steps.expected: Remaining distance is 90 m.

steps.action: Receive an update from RBC setting the SR distance to 200 m.
steps.expected: The OBU deletes the previous virtual train position and creates a new one. The remaining distance is recalculated based on the new distance (200 m) and the current position relative to the new start point (which is the current location). The remaining distance becomes 200 m (assuming the 'start' for the new supervision is the current location, or the distance is re-evaluated from the current position as per 3.6.7.5 're-start'). Note: 3.6.7.5 says 're-start of the supervision', implying the location is the current one. So remaining distance is 200 m.

test_cases.title: Supervision start independent of balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The train is located 50 m away from the nearest balise group in the direction of travel.
test_cases.test_inputs: Roll Away distance: 10 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the calculated remaining distance for test observation.

steps.action: Start the Roll Away Protection supervision.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance based on the current location (50 m from balise), not the balise location. The remaining distance is 10 m.

test_cases.title: MA kabul edilmemesi: SSP/gradient MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamıyor (Non-infill)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2'de çalışmaktadır. Mevcut MA ve SSP/gradient verileri yüklenmiştir. RBC, yeni bir MA göndermeye hazırdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni MA: EOA, mevcut tren ön ucundan (estimated front end) sonra bir konumda. SSP/gradient: Mevcut tren ön ucundan EOA'ya kadar olan mesafenin tamamını kapsamıyor (örneğin, son 100 metre eksik).
test_cases.assumptions: Tren durmuş veya düşük hızda hareket etmektedir. 'Full length' tanımı 3.7.2.3.1'e göre 'estimated front end of the train' ile 'supervised location' (EOA) arasıdır.

steps.action: RBC'den, SSP ve gradient verilerinin MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (tren ön ucundan EOA'ya) kapsamadığı yeni bir MA mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mode profile'ı (varsa) reddeder. Mevcut MA ve SSP/gradient verileri geçerli kalmaya devam eder. HMI'de uygun bir hata veya uyarı mesajı gösterilir.

test_cases.title: MA kabul edilmemesi: SSP/gradient MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamıyor (Infill)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2'de çalışmaktadır. Infill prosedürü aktif veya simüle edilmektedir. Mevcut MA ve SSP/gradient verileri yüklenmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni Infill MA: EOA, infill konum referans noktasından (infill location reference) sonra bir konumda. SSP/gradient: Infill konum referans noktasından EOA'ya kadar olan mesafenin tamamını kapsamıyor.
test_cases.assumptions: Tren, infill alanına girmiş veya girmek üzeredir. 'Full length' tanımı 3.7.2.3.1'e göre 'infill location reference' ile 'supervised location' (EOA) arasıdır.

steps.action: RBC'den, SSP ve gradient verilerinin MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (infill referans noktasından EOA'ya) kapsamadığı yeni bir Infill MA mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mode profile'ı (varsa) reddeder. Mevcut MA ve SSP/gradient verileri geçerli kalmaya devam eder. HMI'de uygun bir hata veya uyarı mesajı gösterilir.

test_cases.title: MA kabul edilmemesi: SSP/gradient MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamıyor (Supervised Manoeuvre, ters yön)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2'de çalışmaktadır. Supervised Manoeuvre (SM) prosedürü aktif. Trenin mevcut yönü ile MA'nın geçerlilik yönü (validity direction) zıttır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni SM MA: Geçerlilik yönü, trenin mevcut yönüne zıttır. EOA, yeni tren yönüne göre tahmini tren ön ucundan (estimated front end derived from new train orientation) sonra bir konumda. SSP/gradient: Yeni yön için tahmini tren ön ucundan EOA'ya kadar olan mesafenin tamamını kapsamıyor.
test_cases.assumptions: Tren, SM prosedürü kapsamında yön değiştirmeye hazırlanmaktadır. 'Full length' tanımı 3.7.2.3.2'ye göre 'estimated front end of the train derived from the new train orientation' ile 'supervised location' (EOA) arasıdır.

steps.action: RBC'den, SSP ve gradient verilerinin MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (yeni yön için tahmini tren ön ucundan EOA'ya) kapsamadığı yeni bir SM MA mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mode profile'ı (varsa) reddeder. Mevcut MA ve SSP/gradient verileri geçerli kalmaya devam eder. HMI'de uygun bir hata veya uyarı mesajı gösterilir.

test_cases.title: MA kabul edilmesi: SSP/gradient MA uzunluğunu tam kapsıyor (Normal)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2'de çalışmaktadır. Mevcut MA ve SSP/gradient verileri yüklenmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni MA: EOA, mevcut tren ön ucundan sonra bir konumda. SSP/gradient: Mevcut tren ön ucundan EOA'ya kadar olan mesafenin tamamını kapsıyor (veya daha fazlasını).
test_cases.assumptions: Tren durmuş veya düşük hızda hareket etmektedir. 'Full length' tanımı 3.7.2.3.1'e göre 'estimated front end of the train' ile 'supervised location' (EOA) arasıdır.

steps.action: RBC'den, SSP ve gradient verilerinin MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (tren ön ucundan EOA'ya) kapsadığı yeni bir MA mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mode profile'ı (varsa) kabul eder. Yeni MA, mevcut MA'nın yerine geçer. HMI'de yeni MA bilgileri (EOA, hız limitleri vb.) güncellenir.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Route Suitability Loading Gauge Information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode and has stored route suitability loading gauge information for a specific route section.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new track description message containing new route suitability loading gauge information.
test_cases.assumptions: The new information is valid and received correctly.

steps.action: Send a new track description message containing new route suitability loading gauge information to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the message.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the stored route suitability loading gauge information.
steps.expected: The stored information matches the new information completely, and the previous stored information is no longer present.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Adhesion Factor Information from Start Location
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored adhesion factor information for a route section starting at location L1.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new track description message containing new adhesion factor information starting at location L2 (where L2 is within the range of the previously stored information).
test_cases.assumptions: Location L2 is defined in the new message.

steps.action: Send a new track description message containing new adhesion factor information starting at location L2.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Linking Information (Non-Infill) from Reference Balise Group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored linking information associated with a reference balise group BG_A.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new track description message containing new non-infill linking information with reference balise group BG_B.
test_cases.assumptions: BG_B is a valid balise group identifier.

steps.action: Send a new track description message containing new non-infill linking information referencing BG_B.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the message.

steps.action: Query the OBU for linking information associated with BG_B.
steps.expected: The stored linking information for BG_B matches the new information.

steps.action: Query the OBU for linking information associated with other balise groups.
steps.expected: The stored linking information for other balise groups is replaced or updated according to the rule 'replace all stored linking information from the reference balise group of the new linking information'. Note: The requirement states 'replace all stored linking information from the reference balise group of the new linking information'. This implies the scope is specific to the new reference. However, clause (m) says 'replace all stored linking information from the reference balise group of the new linking information'. This phrasing is slightly ambiguous. Usually, it means the new info replaces the old info *for that specific reference*. Let's assume the test verifies that the specific reference is updated. If the requirement implies a global replacement of *all* linking info, the test would check that. Given 'from the reference balise group', it likely means the data *starting* from that reference or *associated* with it. Let's stick to verifying the specific reference is updated.

test_cases.title: MA kısaltma isteğinin kabulü (sınır durumu: tren sınırı tam üstünde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA'ya sahiptir. RBC ile iletişim kurulmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği: Önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın İndication supervision limit'i, trenin ön ucunun mevcut konumuyla tam olarak aynı konumda olacak şekilde ayarlanır.
test_cases.assumptions: Gereksinim metninde 'in rear' (gerisinde) ifadesi kullanılmıştır. Sınır durumunda (tam üstünde) kabul edilebilirlik, sistemin 'in rear' tanımına göre belirlenir. Bu test, sınır davranışını doğrulamak için tasarlanmıştır. Varsayım: Sistem, 'in rear' koşulunu 'konum <= limit' olarak değerlendirir veya spesifik bir eşik kullanır. Bu test, sistemin bu sınırda tutarlı bir karar verdiğini ve RBC'yi bilgilendirdiğini doğrular. Not: Spesifik eşik değeri gereksinimde belirtilmediği için, test sistemin mevcut konfigürasyonuna göre davranışını gözlemlemeye yöneliktir. Ancak, tipik ERTMS uygulamalarında 'in rear' genellikle 'geriye doğru mesafe > 0' veya 'konum < limit' olarak yorumlanır. Eğer 'konum == limit' ise, bu 'in rear' değildir. Bu nedenle, bu test vaka, sistemin sınır davranışını (kabul veya ret) ve RBC'ye bildirim yapmasını doğrulamak içindir. Varsayım: Sistem, 'in rear' koşulunu 'tren konumu < limit' olarak değerlendirir. Bu durumda, 'konum == limit' isteği reddedilmelidir. Ancak, gereksinim 'in rear' derken 'geriye doğru' kastediyorsa, eşitlik durumu belirsizdir. Bu test, sistemin bu belirsiz sınırda tutarlı bir karar verdiğini ve RBC'ye bildirdiğini doğrulamak için kullanılır. Daha güvenli bir varsayım: 'in rear' = 'tren konumu < limit'. Bu durumda, 'konum == limit' isteği reddedilmelidir. Bu test vaka, bu varsayım altında reddedilme senaryosunu test eder. Alternatif olarak, 'in rear' = 'tren konumu <= limit' ise kabul edilir. Bu test, sistemin belirlenen eşik davranışını doğrulamak içindir. Varsayım: Sistem, 'in rear' koşulunu 'tren konumu < limit' olarak değerlendirir.

steps.action: RBC'den, trenin ön ucunun önerilen MA'nın İndication supervision limit'iyle tam olarak aynı konumda olduğu bir MA kısaltma isteği gönderilir.

Varsayım: 'in rear' = 'konum < limit' ise, istek reddedilir. 'in rear' = 'konum <= limit' ise, istek kabul edilir. Test, sistemin mevcut konfigürasyonuna göre davranışını gözlemlemeye yöneliktir.

steps.expected: Hesaplama, T41, T_bs1 ve T_bs2 değerlerini, fren geri beslemesi veya traksiyon kesimi uygulanmış gibi değil, uygulanmamış gibi tanımlanmış sabit değerlerle yapar.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area start indication based on estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode. A tunnel stopping area is stored on-board. The train is moving towards the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed, position of the estimated front end of the train, start location of the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'estimated front end' is calculated by the OBU based on current speed and driver reaction time as per Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end of the train reaches the calculated point C (in rear of the start location D of the tunnel stopping area).
steps.expected: The OBU displays the 'Tunnel Stopping Area announcement' to the driver.

steps.action: Continue moving the train such that the estimated front end of the train is still in rear of point C.
steps.expected: The 'Tunnel Stopping Area announcement' is not displayed.

test_cases.title: Sound horn indication start based on estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode. A 'sound horn' track condition area is stored on-board. The train is moving towards the sound horn area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed, position of the estimated front end of the train, start location (point D) of the sound horn area.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'estimated front end' is calculated by the OBU based on current speed and driver reaction time as per Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end of the train reaches the calculated point C (in rear of the start location D of the sound horn area).
steps.expected: The OBU displays the 'Sound horn' indication to the driver.

steps.action: Continue moving the train such that the estimated front end of the train is still in rear of point C.
steps.expected: The 'Sound horn' indication is not displayed.

test_cases.title: Sound horn indication end based on estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is displaying the 'Sound horn' indication. The train is moving through the sound horn area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed, position of the estimated front end of the train, end location (point E) of the sound horn area.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end of the train reaches the end location (point E) of the sound horn area.
steps.expected: The 'Sound horn' indication is no longer displayed.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end of the train is just before point E.
steps.expected: The 'Sound horn' indication is still displayed.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area evaluation with high speed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode. A tunnel stopping area is stored on-board.
test_cases.test_inputs: High train speed, position of the estimated front end of the train, start location of the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.assumptions: At higher speeds, the distance between point C and point D increases due to the longer reaction time and braking distance.

steps.action: Set the train to a high speed and move it such that the estimated front end reaches the calculated point C for this speed.
steps.expected: The 'Tunnel Stopping Area announcement' is displayed.

steps.action: Verify that the distance between point C and point D is greater than at lower speeds.
steps.expected: The indication appears earlier (further away from point D) compared to lower speed scenarios.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area evaluation with low speed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode. A tunnel stopping area is stored on-board.
test_cases.test_inputs: Low train speed, position of the estimated front end of the train, start location of the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.assumptions: At lower speeds, the distance between point C and point D decreases.

steps.action: Set the train to a low speed and move it such that the estimated front end reaches the calculated point C for this speed.
steps.expected: The 'Tunnel Stopping Area announcement' is displayed.

steps.action: Verify that the distance between point C and point D is smaller than at higher speeds.
steps.expected: The indication appears later (closer to point D) compared to higher speed scenarios.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: Loading gauge unsuitability
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train Data is configured with a specific loading gauge profile (e.g., 'G1').
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside containing a list of accepted loading gauges that does NOT include the train's current loading gauge ('G1').
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows injection of simulated trackside messages for testing.

steps.action: Inject route suitability data from trackside where the list of accepted loading gauges excludes the train's configured loading gauge.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and identifies a loading gauge unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status and driver interface.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the unsuitability to exist. The closest location corresponding to the unsuitability is treated as a temporary EOA and SvL with no Release Speed. The driver is informed about the unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: Axle load category unsuitability
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train Data is configured with a specific axle load category (e.g., 'A').
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside containing a list of permitted axle load categories that does NOT include the train's current axle load category ('A').
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows injection of simulated trackside messages for testing.

steps.action: Inject route suitability data from trackside where the list of permitted axle load categories excludes the train's configured axle load category.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and identifies an axle load category unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status and driver interface.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the unsuitability to exist. The closest location corresponding to the unsuitability is treated as a temporary EOA and SvL with no Release Speed. The driver is informed about the unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: Traction system unsuitability
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train Data is configured with a specific traction system (e.g., 'Electric 25kV'). The engine is NOT capable of running on a line without any traction system.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside containing a list of accepted traction systems that does NOT include the train's current traction system.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows injection of simulated trackside messages for testing.

steps.action: Inject route suitability data from trackside where the list of accepted traction systems excludes the train's configured traction system.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and identifies a traction system unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status and driver interface.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the unsuitability to exist. The closest location corresponding to the unsuitability is treated as a temporary EOA and SvL with no Release Speed. The driver is informed about the unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: All parameters suitable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train Data is configured with specific loading gauge, axle load category, and traction system.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside where the train's loading gauge, axle load category, and traction system are all included in the respective accepted/permitted lists.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows injection of simulated trackside messages for testing.

steps.action: Inject route suitability data from trackside where all train parameters match the accepted lists.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and finds no unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status and driver interface.
steps.expected: No unsuitability is reported. No temporary EOA or SvL is created due to route suitability. The train is permitted to run without restriction from this check.

test_cases.title: Traction system unsuitability exception: Engine can run without traction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train Data is configured with a specific traction system (e.g., 'Electric 25kV'). The engine is configured/capable of running on a line without any traction system.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside containing a list of accepted traction systems that does NOT include the train's current traction system.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows injection of simulated trackside messages for testing. The engine capability flag is set to 'can run without traction'.

steps.action: Inject route suitability data from trackside where the list of accepted traction systems excludes the train's configured traction system.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data. Despite the mismatch, it does NOT identify a traction system unsuitability because the engine can run on a line without any traction system.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status and driver interface.
steps.expected: No traction system unsuitability is reported. No temporary EOA or SvL is created due to traction system mismatch.

test_cases.title: No route suitability data: Initial state and operation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. No route suitability data has been received from trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (absence of data).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows monitoring of internal state and supervision logic.

steps.action: Verify the OBU's initial state regarding route suitability.
steps.expected: The OBU's initial state indicates that no route suitability restriction exists. No default values are used or supervised.

steps.action: Allow the train to run (simulate movement) without receiving any route suitability data.
steps.expected: The OBU allows the train to run. No unsuitability is detected, and no temporary EOA or SvL is created due to route suitability.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for auxiliary information without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and display text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with class 'auxiliary information' and 'driver acknowledgement not requested'.

steps.action: Send a text message to the OBU with class 'auxiliary information' and no driver acknowledgement request.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message with the appearance defined for auxiliary information without acknowledgement.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for important information with acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and display text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with class 'important information' and 'driver acknowledgement requested'.

steps.action: Send a text message to the OBU with class 'important information' and driver acknowledgement requested.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message with the appearance defined for important information with acknowledgement.

test_cases.title: Start condition fulfilled when ANY sub-condition is met
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and display text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with two start sub-conditions (e.g., location and speed) and the definition 'ANY' (OR logic).

steps.action: Send a text message with two start sub-conditions (e.g., location A and speed > 50 km/h) and the definition 'ANY'.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the message and does not display it yet.

steps.action: Fulfill only the first sub-condition (e.g., reach location A) while the second is not met (speed < 50 km/h).
steps.expected: The OBU considers the start condition fulfilled and displays the message.

test_cases.title: Start condition fulfilled when ALL sub-conditions are met
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and display text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with two start sub-conditions (e.g., location and speed) and the definition 'ALL' (AND logic).

steps.action: Send a text message with two start sub-conditions (e.g., location A and speed > 50 km/h) and the definition 'ALL'.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the message and does not display it yet.

steps.action: Fulfill only the first sub-condition (e.g., reach location A) while the second is not met (speed < 50 km/h).
steps.expected: The OBU does not display the message.

steps.action: Fulfill the second sub-condition (increase speed > 50 km/h) while the first remains fulfilled.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the start condition fulfilled and displays the message.

test_cases.title: Start condition immediately fulfilled when no sub-conditions defined
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and display text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with no start sub-conditions defined.

steps.action: Send a text message to the OBU with no start sub-conditions defined.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the start condition as immediately fulfilled and displays the message (assuming end condition is not immediately fulfilled).

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement always ends display regardless of end condition
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is displaying a text message that requests driver acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with driver acknowledgement requested, defined as 'always ending the text display'.

steps.action: Display a text message that requests driver acknowledgement, defined as 'always ending the text display'.
steps.expected: The message is displayed and waiting for acknowledgement.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message before the end condition is fulfilled.
steps.expected: The text display ends immediately, regardless of the end condition status.

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement is necessary condition in addition to end condition
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is displaying a text message that requests driver acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with driver acknowledgement requested, defined as 'necessary condition to end the text display'.

steps.action: Display a text message that requests driver acknowledgement, defined as 'necessary condition to end the text display'.
steps.expected: The message is displayed and waiting for acknowledgement and end condition.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message before the end condition is fulfilled.
steps.expected: The text display does not end; it remains displayed.

steps.action: Fulfill the end condition.
steps.expected: The text display ends because both the end condition and acknowledgement are fulfilled.

test_cases.title: No display if end condition is immediately fulfilled
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and display text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message where the start condition is fulfilled and the end condition is also immediately fulfilled.

steps.action: Send a text message where the start condition is fulfilled and the end condition is also immediately fulfilled (e.g., start at location A, end at location A).
steps.expected: The OBU does not display the message at all.

test_cases.title: Display length measured from start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and display text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with start condition including location A and end condition including location B, with a defined display length.

steps.action: Send a text message with start condition including location A and end condition including location B, with a defined display length.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the message.

steps.action: Fulfill the start condition at location A.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message and measures the display length from location A.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement report sent to RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is displaying a text message that requests a report of driver acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with a request to report driver acknowledgement to a specific RBC.

steps.action: Display a text message that requests a report of driver acknowledgement to a specific RBC.
steps.expected: The message is displayed and waiting for acknowledgement.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a driver acknowledgement report, including the text message identifier, to the referenced RBC.

test_cases.title: Reject new message with same identifier as unacknowledged message
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has received a text message with a specific identifier that has not yet been acknowledged by the driver.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new text message with the same identifier as the previously received unacknowledged message.

steps.action: Receive a text message with identifier X that requests a report of driver acknowledgement, and do not acknowledge it.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the message and waits for acknowledgement.

steps.action: Receive a new text message with the same identifier X that requests a report of driver acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new text message.

test_cases.title: Infill MA ile OS Mode Profile'in kısmi silinmesi

test_cases.title: Infill MA ile SH Mode Profile'in silinmesi (Referans başlangıçta veya arkasında)

test_cases.title: Mode Profile başlangıcının geçici EOA olarak kullanılması
