steps.expected: The system processes the identity proofing request.

steps.action: Complete the identity proofing verification steps successfully.
steps.expected: The system confirms the identity and successfully completes the account recovery.

test_cases.title: Recovery failure with two recovery codes from the same method
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account with maximum AAL2 is in recovery mode. The user has two valid recovery codes from the same method (e.g., both saved).
test_cases.test_inputs: Two valid recovery codes from the same method.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process and select the option to use two recovery codes.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the first recovery code.

steps.action: Enter the first valid recovery code from Method A.
steps.expected: The system accepts the first code and prompts for the second.

steps.action: Enter the second valid recovery code from Method A (same method as the first).
steps.expected: The system rejects the recovery attempt, indicating that the codes must be from different methods.

test_cases.title: Recovery failure with invalid recovery code
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account with maximum AAL2 is in recovery mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: An invalid or expired recovery code.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process and select the option to use a recovery code.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the recovery code.

steps.action: Enter an invalid recovery code.
steps.expected: The system rejects the code and displays an error message indicating the code is invalid.

test_cases.title: Multiple authenticators disabled upon reaching failure threshold
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with both password and a second factor (e.g., OTP) enabled. The failure threshold is defined in VBP SDD §14 (assumed to be 5 for this test).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, incorrect password, incorrect second factor code.
test_cases.assumptions: The threshold for consecutive failed attempts is 5, as per VBP SDD §14. The system tracks failures per authenticator and per account.

steps.action: Attempt login with the correct username, an incorrect password, and an incorrect second factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication fails. The system records a failed attempt for both the password and the second factor authenticators.

steps.action: Repeat the login attempt with incorrect credentials for the remaining number of attempts required to reach the threshold (e.g., 4 more times if threshold is 5).
steps.expected: Each attempt fails. The system continues to record failures for both authenticators.

steps.action: Check the status of the password and second factor authenticators for the account.
steps.expected: Both the password and the second factor authenticators are disabled for the account, as specified in NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.2.2.

test_cases.title: Single authenticator failure does not disable other authenticators
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with both password and a second factor enabled. The failure threshold is 5.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, incorrect password, correct second factor code.
test_cases.assumptions: The system only disables authenticators involved in the failed attempts. If only the password is wrong, only the password authenticator is considered for the failure count.

steps.action: Attempt login with the correct username, an incorrect password, and a correct second factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication fails due to the incorrect password. The system records a failed attempt for the password authenticator only.

steps.action: Repeat the login attempt with an incorrect password and correct second factor code until the threshold is reached.
steps.expected: Each attempt fails. The system records failures for the password authenticator.

steps.action: Check the status of the password and second factor authenticators for the account.
steps.expected: The password authenticator is disabled. The second factor authenticator remains enabled, as it was not involved in the failed attempts (or its failure count did not reach the threshold independently).

test_cases.title: Rebinding required after disabling multiple authenticators
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account has had both password and second factor disabled due to reaching the failure threshold.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account recovery credentials or admin access to re-enable authenticators.
test_cases.assumptions: The system requires re-binding of disabled authenticators before they can be used again, as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.

steps.action: Attempt to re-enable the password authenticator without completing the re-binding process.
steps.expected: The system prevents the use of the password authenticator until the re-binding process is completed.

steps.action: Complete the re-binding process for the password authenticator.
steps.expected: The password authenticator is re-enabled and can be used for authentication.

steps.action: Attempt to re-enable the second factor authenticator without completing the re-binding process.
steps.expected: The system prevents the use of the second factor authenticator until the re-binding process is completed.

steps.action: Complete the re-binding process for the second factor authenticator.
steps.expected: The second factor authenticator is re-enabled and can be used for authentication.

test_cases.title: Disabled authenticator requires re-binding before use
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. An authenticator bound to this account has been disabled due to reaching the failed-attempt threshold defined in VBP SDD §14.
test_cases.test_inputs: Credentials for the disabled authenticator.
test_cases.assumptions: The failed-attempt threshold is defined in VBP SDD §14. The re-binding process follows NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate using the disabled authenticator without re-binding.
steps.expected: Authentication fails. The system indicates that the authenticator is disabled and requires re-binding.

steps.action: Initiate the re-binding process for the disabled authenticator to the company representative account as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.
steps.expected: The re-binding process completes successfully. The authenticator status changes to active/bound.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate using the re-bound authenticator.
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds. The user is granted access.

test_cases.title: Authentication fails if re-binding is not completed
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. An authenticator bound to this account has been disabled due to reaching the failed-attempt threshold defined in VBP SDD §14.
test_cases.test_inputs: Credentials for the disabled authenticator.
test_cases.assumptions: The re-binding process can be interrupted or failed.

steps.action: Initiate the re-binding process for the disabled authenticator but do not complete it (e.g., cancel or fail a step).
steps.expected: The authenticator remains in a disabled state.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate using the authenticator.
steps.expected: Authentication fails. The system indicates that the authenticator is not properly bound/active.

test_cases.title: AAL2 altında gelen e-Devlet yanıtının sınırlı kipte işlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet federasyonu için AAL2'yi minimum kabul edilen düzey olarak yapılandırmıştır. Test ortamında e-Devlet IdP'si AAL1 düzeyinde yanıt üretebilmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: AAL1 düzeyinde kimlik doğrulama yapılmış bir e-Devlet oturumu.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP'nin 'sınırlı kip' davranışı, tasarım belgesinde belirtildiği gibi kişisel veri ve başvuru içeriğinin gizlenmesini ve yeniden giriş önerisini içerir.

steps.action: AAL1 düzeyinde doğrulanmış e-Devlet oturumuyla VBP'ye giriş yapılır.
steps.expected: VBP, gelen yanıtın AAL2 gereksinimini karşılamadığını algılar ve oturumu 'sınırlı kip'te açar.

steps.action: Sınırlı kipte kullanıcı arayüzü incelenir.
steps.expected: Kişisel veri ve başvuru içeriği gösterilmez; daha güçlü bir doğrulama yöntemiyle yeniden giriş önerisi sunulur.

test_cases.title: Gerekli xAL değerlerini karşılamayan yanıtın reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, belirli bir işlev için minimum IAL2 ve AAL2 gerektirmektedir. Test ortamında e-Devlet IdP'si bu değerlerin altında bir yanıt üretebilmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: IAL1 ve AAL1 düzeylerinde kimlik doğrulama yapılmış bir e-Devlet yanıtı.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP, minimum xAL değerlerini karşılamayan istekleri 'reddetme' mekanizmasıyla ele alır.

steps.action: IAL1 ve AAL1 düzeylerinde doğrulanmış e-Devlet yanıtıyla VBP'ye korumalı bir kaynağa erişim denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: VBP, yanıtın minimum IAL ve AAL gereksinimlerini karşılamadığını belirler ve isteği reddeder.

steps.action: Kullanıcıya gösterilen hata mesajı incelenir.
steps.expected: Kullanıcıya, erişimin neden reddedildiğine dair tanımlı bir mekanizma (örneğin, istek reddedildi veya istisna işleme yönlendirildi) bildirilir.

test_cases.title: Gerekli xAL değerlerini karşılayan yanıtın normal işlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet federasyonu için minimum IAL1 ve AAL2 gerektirmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: IAL1 ve AAL2 düzeylerinde kimlik doğrulama yapılmış bir e-Devlet yanıtı.

steps.action: IAL1 ve AAL2 düzeylerinde doğrulanmış e-Devlet yanıtıyla VBP'ye giriş yapılır.
steps.expected: VBP, yanıtın minimum xAL gereksinimlerini karşıladığını doğrular ve isteği reddetmez veya sınırlı kipe yönlendirmez.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, korumalı kaynaklara erişir.
steps.expected: Kullanıcı, tam yetkilerle oturum açar ve kişisel veri ile başvuru içeriğine erişebilir.

test_cases.title: Session AAL cannot exceed authentication event AAL
test_cases.preconditions: A user account exists with authentication capabilities for AAL1 and AAL2. The system allows session creation based on authentication events.
test_cases.test_inputs: User credentials for AAL1 authentication. A request to access a resource requiring AAL2 session context.
test_cases.assumptions: The system logs the AAL level of the authentication event and the resulting session. Access to AAL2 resources requires a session with AAL2 or higher.

steps.action: Authenticate the user using an AAL1 method (e.g., password only).
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds. The system creates a session associated with AAL1.

steps.action: Attempt to access a resource or function that requires an AAL2 session context using the current session.
steps.expected: The system denies access or prompts for re-authentication at AAL2. The session is not treated as AAL2. The session AAL remains AAL1.

test_cases.title: Session AAL can be lower than authentication event AAL
test_cases.preconditions: A user account exists with authentication capabilities for AAL2. The system allows session creation based on authentication events.
test_cases.test_inputs: User credentials for AAL2 authentication (e.g., password + OTP).
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows the session to be established at a lower AAL than the authentication event if configured or if the user chooses a lower security context for the session, or if the session inherits the AAL but is used in a context that only requires lower AAL. The requirement states 'treating it at a lower AAL is permitted'. This test verifies that a high AAL authentication does not force a high AAL session if the system logic allows downgrading or if the session is used for lower AAL purposes without error.

steps.action: Authenticate the user using an AAL2 method.
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds. The system creates a session. The session is capable of being treated at AAL2.

steps.action: Access a resource that only requires AAL1 session context using the current session.
steps.expected: Access is granted. The session is treated as sufficient for AAL1 (which is lower than the AAL2 authentication event). No error occurs.

test_cases.title: Authenticated session does not fall back to HTTP
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı portal üzerinde kimlik doğrulamasını başarıyla tamamlamış ve aktif bir HTTPS oturumuna sahiptir.

steps.action: Aktif oturumda iken tarayıcı adres çubuğuna mevcut sayfanın HTTP protokolü ile (http://) URL'si girilir.
steps.expected: Sistem isteği reddeder veya otomatik olarak HTTPS protokolüne yönlendirir; oturumun HTTP üzerinden devam etmesine izin verilmez.

steps.action: Oturumun aktif olduğu sayfada bir form gönderimi veya API isteği yapılır.
steps.expected: Tüm istekler ve yanıtlar HTTPS protokolü üzerinden iletilir; hiçbir istek HTTP protokolüne düşmez.

test_cases.title: Prevention of protocol downgrade during active session
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı portal üzerinde kimlik doğrulamasını başarıyla tamamlamış ve aktif bir HTTPS oturumuna sahiptir.
test_cases.assumptions: Test ortamında istemci tarafında protokol manipülasyonu yapılabilecek bir araç (örneğin proxy veya tarayıcı eklentisi) mevcuttur.

steps.action: Aktif oturum sırasında, istemci tarafında bir araç kullanılarak mevcut HTTPS oturumunun HTTP protokolüne düşürülmesi (protocol downgrade) denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Sistem bu denemeyi algılar ve oturumu sonlandırır veya güvenli bir şekilde HTTPS'e geri döndürür; hassas verilerin HTTP üzerinden iletilmesine izin verilmez.

test_cases.title: Bot detection blocks automated script attempts
test_cases.preconditions: The VBP identity proofing endpoint is accessible. A standard HTTP client capable of sending automated requests is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: A sequence of HTTP requests mimicking a bot (e.g., missing browser headers, rapid sequential requests without human-like delays).
test_cases.assumptions: The system's bot detection mechanism is configured to flag requests lacking standard browser characteristics or exhibiting non-human timing patterns.

steps.action: Send a series of rapid, automated HTTP requests to the identity proofing initiation endpoint using a script that omits standard browser headers (User-Agent, Accept-Language).
steps.expected: The system detects the automated nature of the requests. The requests are blocked or challenged (e.g., CAPTCHA, 403 Forbidden, or redirect to a security check page) rather than proceeding to the proofing form.

steps.action: Verify the server logs or security dashboard for the specific IP address used in Step 1.
steps.expected: The logs indicate that the requests were flagged by the bot detection or WAF component as potential automated attacks.

test_cases.title: Web Application Firewall blocks SQL injection attempts
test_cases.preconditions: The VBP identity proofing form is accessible. The WAF is active and configured to detect common injection attacks.
test_cases.test_inputs: A form submission containing a SQL injection payload in a text field (e.g., '1' OR '1'='1').
test_cases.assumptions: The WAF rules are configured to detect and block standard SQL injection patterns.

steps.action: Navigate to the company representative identity proofing form.
steps.expected: The form loads successfully.

steps.action: Enter a SQL injection payload into a text input field (e.g., the 'Company Name' field) and submit the form.
steps.expected: The WAF intercepts the request. The user receives a generic error message or a block page indicating that the request was rejected due to security policy. The database is not queried with the malicious input.

test_cases.title: Network traffic analysis flags high-risk IP addresses
test_cases.preconditions: The VBP is accessible. A test client is configured to route traffic through a known high-risk or blocklisted proxy/IP address.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid identity proofing request initiated from a blocklisted IP address.
test_cases.assumptions: The system maintains a list of high-risk or blocklisted IP addresses/proxies and checks incoming traffic against this list.

steps.action: Initiate the identity proofing process from a client configured to use a known blocklisted IP address or proxy.
steps.expected: The system's network traffic analysis component identifies the source IP as high-risk. The request is blocked, or the user is presented with an additional verification step (e.g., out-of-band confirmation) before proceeding.

test_cases.title: Behavioral analytics detects abnormal user interaction patterns
test_cases.preconditions: The VBP identity proofing form is accessible. The behavioral analytics module is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: User interaction data simulating non-human behavior (e.g., filling all form fields in less than 1 second, no mouse movement, perfect keystroke timing).
test_cases.assumptions: The behavioral analytics system is configured to flag interactions that deviate significantly from human typing and navigation patterns.

steps.action: Use an automation tool to fill out the identity proofing form fields with valid data at a speed significantly faster than human capability (e.g., <100ms per field) and submit the form.
steps.expected: The behavioral analytics engine flags the session as suspicious due to the abnormal interaction speed and pattern. The submission is blocked or challenged with a security verification step.

test_cases.title: Legitimate user access is not blocked by security controls
test_cases.preconditions: A valid test user account for a company representative exists. The user is accessing the system from a clean, non-blocklisted IP address using a standard browser.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid identity proofing data entered manually by a human user.
test_cases.assumptions: The security controls (WAF, bot detection, behavioral analytics) are tuned to allow normal human traffic without false positives.

steps.action: Log in as a valid company representative and navigate to the identity proofing section.
steps.expected: The identity proofing form loads without any security challenges or blocks.

steps.action: Manually enter valid identity proofing data into the form fields at a normal human pace and submit the form.
steps.expected: The form is submitted successfully. The system proceeds to the next step of the identity proofing process (e.g., document upload or verification) without triggering any automated attack protection alerts.

test_cases.title: Geçerli TOTP kodunun ilk girişte kabul edilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı TOTP doğrulayıcısına sahiptir ve oturum açma işleminde ikinci faktör aşamasındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli bir TOTP kodu.

steps.action: Geçerli bir TOTP kodu girilir ve doğrulama istenir.
steps.expected: Sistem kodu kabul eder ve kimlik doğrulama başarılı olarak tamamlanır.

test_cases.title: Aynı TOTP kodunun ikinci kez kullanımının reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı geçerli bir TOTP kodu ile başarılı bir şekilde kimlik doğrulaması yapmıştır ve kod hâlâ geçerlilik süresi içindedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Daha önce kullanılmış olan aynı TOTP kodu.

steps.action: Daha önce kullanılmış olan aynı TOTP kodu, yeni bir doğrulama denemesinde girilir.
steps.expected: Sistem kodu reddeder ve 'kod zaten kullanıldı' veya benzeri bir hata mesajı gösterir.

test_cases.title: Geçerlilik süresi dolan TOTP kodunun reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı TOTP doğrulama aşamasındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerlilik süresi dolmuş bir TOTP kodu.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem saati güvenilir kaynaktan alınmaktadır ve TOTP kabul penceresi 59 saniyedir (geçerli adım + bir önceki adım).

steps.action: Geçerlilik süresi dolmuş (kabul penceresi dışında) bir TOTP kodu girilir.
steps.expected: Sistem kodu reddeder ve 'kodun süresi doldu' veya benzeri bir hata mesajı gösterir.

test_cases.title: Replacement recovery code issuance triggers notification
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a valid saved recovery code. The account has a valid notification address (e.g., email) configured.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the company representative. Request to replace the current saved recovery code.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to send notifications via the configured channel (e.g., email). The notification content complies with NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.6.

steps.action: Log in as the company representative and request a replacement for the current saved recovery code.
steps.expected: The system generates a new saved recovery code and invalidates the old one.

steps.action: Check the notification channel (e.g., email inbox) associated with the account.
steps.expected: An account recovery notification is received, indicating that a recovery code replacement occurred.

test_cases.title: Notification sent when no other notification address exists
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. The account has no email or phone notification addresses configured, only a postal address.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the company representative. Request to replace the current saved recovery code.
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports postal notifications as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.6 when no other address is available.

steps.action: Log in as the company representative and request a replacement for the current saved recovery code.
steps.expected: The system generates a new saved recovery code.

steps.action: Verify the notification dispatch log or postal service integration.
steps.expected: A notification is queued or sent to the postal address of the account.

test_cases.title: Notification sent when only recovery code address is available
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. The only notification address stored is the address to which an issued recovery code was previously sent (e.g., a specific email). No other email or phone is configured.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the company representative. Request to replace the current saved recovery code.
test_cases.assumptions: The system treats the 'issued recovery code address' as a valid notification target if it is the only one available, per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.6.

steps.action: Log in as the company representative and request a replacement for the current saved recovery code.
steps.expected: The system generates a new saved recovery code.

steps.action: Check the notification channel associated with the 'issued recovery code address'.
steps.expected: An account recovery notification is received at that specific address.

test_cases.title: Saved recovery code invalidation and new code issuance upon successful use
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a valid saved recovery code. The account is in a state where recovery is required (e.g., password reset or MFA reset).
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid saved recovery code.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows triggering the account recovery flow for testing purposes.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for a saved recovery code.

steps.action: Enter the valid saved recovery code and submit it.
steps.expected: The system accepts the code and completes the recovery process (e.g., allows password reset).

steps.action: Check the status of the previously used saved recovery code in the system database or admin interface.
steps.expected: The previously used recovery code is marked as invalid or deleted.

steps.action: Check the company representative's account for a new saved recovery code.
steps.expected: A new saved recovery code is generated and associated with the account.

steps.action: Attempt to use the previously used (now invalid) recovery code in a new recovery session.
steps.expected: The system rejects the code as invalid.

test_cases.title: Recovery code remains valid if recovery process is not completed
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a valid saved recovery code.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid saved recovery code.
test_cases.assumptions: The recovery process can be interrupted after code entry but before completion.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process and enter the valid saved recovery code.
steps.expected: The system accepts the code input.

steps.action: Abort the recovery process before completing the final step (e.g., close the browser or click cancel).
steps.expected: The recovery process is terminated without success.

steps.action: Check the status of the saved recovery code in the system.
steps.expected: The saved recovery code remains valid and has not been invalidated.

steps.action: Check the account for a new saved recovery code.
steps.expected: No new saved recovery code has been issued.

test_cases.title: AAL2 ile hesap erişimi sağlanması
test_cases.preconditions: AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulama yapılmış ve hesapta kayıtlı iki farklı doğrulayıcı (ör. parola + SMS kodu) bulunan bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı vardır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli kullanıcı adı, kayıtlı parola, kayıtlı SMS doğrulama kodu.

steps.action: Temsilci, kullanıcı adı ve kayıtlı parolası ile giriş yapar.
steps.expected: Sistem, ikinci faktör doğrulaması için SMS kodu ister.

steps.action: Temsilci, kayıtlı telefon numarasına gelen geçerli SMS kodunu girer.
steps.expected: Giriş başarılı olur ve temsilci, kişisel bilgilerini içeren hesabına erişir.

test_cases.title: AAL3 ile hesap erişimi sağlanması
test_cases.preconditions: AAL3 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulama yapılmış ve hesapta kayıtlı bir FIDO2/WebAuthn anahtarı bulunan bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı vardır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli kullanıcı adı, kayıtlı FIDO2/WebAuthn doğrulayıcısı.

steps.action: Temsilci, kullanıcı adı ile giriş yapar ve kayıtlı FIDO2/WebAuthn doğrulayıcısını (ör. parmak izi veya PIN) kullanır.
steps.expected: Giriş başarılı olur ve temsilci, kişisel bilgilerini içeren hesabına erişir.

test_cases.title: AAL1 ile hesap erişiminin reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sadece AAL1 seviyesinde (tek faktör, örn. sadece parola) kimlik doğrulama yapılmış bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı vardır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli kullanıcı adı, kayıtlı parola.

steps.action: Temsilci, kullanıcı adı ve parolası ile giriş yapar.
steps.expected: Sistem, kişisel bilgi içeren hesaba erişim için AAL2 veya AAL3 gerektirdiğini belirten bir hata mesajı gösterir ve erişimi reddeder.

test_cases.title: Hesaba kayıtlı olmayan doğrulayıcı ile erişimin reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulama yapılmış bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı vardır. Hesaba kayıtlı olmayan bir telefon numarası veya doğrulayıcı vardır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli kullanıcı adı, kayıtlı parola, hesaba kayıtlı olmayan bir telefon numarası.

steps.action: Temsilci, kullanıcı adı ve parolası ile giriş yapar.
steps.expected: Sistem, ikinci faktör doğrulaması için hesaba kayıtlı doğrulayıcıları listeler.

steps.action: Temsilci, hesaba kayıtlı olmayan bir telefon numarası ile SMS kodu istemeye çalışır veya bu numaraya gelen bir kodu girer.
steps.expected: Sistem, doğrulayıcının hesaba kayıtlı olmadığını belirten bir hata mesajı gösterir ve erişimi reddeder.

test_cases.title: Representative account information update notification
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists and is active. The representative has a valid notification channel (e.g., email) configured.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid update request for a non-core attribute (e.g., phone number) in the representative account.
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports updating non-core attributes directly by the subscriber as per NIST SP 800-63A-4 §5.3.

steps.action: Log in as the company representative and request an update to a non-core attribute in their account.
steps.expected: The system accepts the update request and processes the change.

steps.action: Check the representative's notification channel (e.g., email inbox).
steps.expected: A notification is received informing the representative that an update was made to their account information.

test_cases.title: Notification content verification for account update
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. A notification has been triggered by a recent account update.
test_cases.test_inputs: The notification message generated by the system.
test_cases.assumptions: The notification mechanism is functional and delivers messages to the configured channel.

steps.action: Retrieve the notification message sent to the representative following an account update.
steps.expected: The message explicitly states that an update was made to the representative's account information.

test_cases.title: Company representative reports unauthorized access
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists and is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: A report indicating unauthorized access to account information.
test_cases.assumptions: The system provides a specific interface or form for reporting security incidents as per NIST SP 800-63A-4 §5.3.

steps.action: Log in as a company representative.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated and directed to the account dashboard.

steps.action: Navigate to the account security or support section and select the option to report unauthorized access or potential compromise.
steps.expected: A form or interface for reporting the incident is displayed.

steps.action: Submit the report with details describing the suspected unauthorized access.
steps.expected: The system accepts the report and displays a confirmation message or ticket number.

test_cases.title: Company representative reports potential compromise
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists and is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: A report indicating a potential compromise of account information.
test_cases.assumptions: The system distinguishes between 'unauthorized access' and 'potential compromise' or accepts both under a general security report mechanism.

steps.action: Log in as a company representative.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated.

steps.action: Access the security reporting feature and select 'Potential Compromise'.
steps.expected: The relevant reporting form is displayed.

steps.action: Submit the report with details of the potential compromise.
steps.expected: The system records the report and provides a confirmation to the user.

test_cases.title: Unauthenticated user cannot report unauthorized access
test_cases.preconditions: The user is not logged in.
test_cases.test_inputs: Attempt to access the security reporting feature without authentication.
test_cases.assumptions: The reporting feature is restricted to authenticated company representatives.

steps.action: Attempt to access the URL or link for reporting unauthorized access while not logged in.
steps.expected: The system redirects the user to the login page or displays an access denied message.

test_cases.title: Beklenmeyen hata durumunda genel mesaj gösterimi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde beklenmeyen bir hatayı tetikleyecek bir senaryo (örneğin, null pointer exception veya veritabanı bağlantı hatası) simüle edilebilir durumda olmalıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Hata tetikleyici bir istek (örneğin, geçersiz bir parametre ile API çağrısı).
test_cases.assumptions: Hata loglarına erişim yetkisi vardır ve loglar ayrıntılı bilgi içermektedir.

steps.action: Beklenmeyen bir hatayı tetikleyecek şekilde bir istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: Kullanıcıya genel bir hata mesajı döner. Mesajda yığın izi (stack trace), SQL sorgusu, gizli anahtar, token veya sürüm bilgisi gibi iç detaylar bulunmaz.

steps.action: Hata kayıtları (loglar) incelenir.
steps.expected: Loglarda hatanın ayrıntılı teknik bilgileri (yığın izi, sorgu vb.) kaydedilmiştir.

test_cases.title: Güvenlik hassasiyetli hata durumunda genel mesaj gösterimi
test_cases.preconditions: Güvenlik hassasiyetli bir hata senaryosu (örneğin, yetkilendirme hatası veya kimlik doğrulama hatası) oluşturulabilir durumda olmalıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yetkisiz bir kullanıcı ile hassas bir kaynağa erişim denemesi.

steps.action: Yetkisiz bir kullanıcı ile hassas bir kaynağa erişim denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Kullanıcıya genel bir hata mesajı döner. Mesajda yetkilendirme detayları, kullanıcı kimliği veya sistem içi yapılar gibi hassas bilgiler yer almaz.

steps.action: Hata kayıtları (loglar) incelenir.
steps.expected: Loglarda hatanın ayrıntılı teknik bilgileri ve güvenlik olayı detayları kaydedilmiştir.

test_cases.title: Session cookie has HttpOnly attribute and is set via Set-Cookie header
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists. The user is not logged in.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the test account.
test_cases.assumptions: The session cookie name is known or can be identified from the response headers.

steps.action: Log in to the portal with valid credentials.
steps.expected: The login is successful and the user is redirected to the dashboard.

steps.action: Inspect the HTTP response headers from the login request for the 'Set-Cookie' field containing the session cookie.
steps.expected: The 'Set-Cookie' header is present and contains the session cookie.

steps.action: Check the attributes of the session cookie in the 'Set-Cookie' header.
steps.expected: The 'HttpOnly' attribute is present in the cookie definition.

steps.action: Execute JavaScript in the browser console to access the session cookie value (e.g., document.cookie).
steps.expected: The session cookie value is not accessible via JavaScript.

test_cases.title: Non-session cookies not meant for client-side access have HttpOnly attribute
test_cases.preconditions: The portal sets at least one non-session cookie that is not intended to be accessible by client-side scripts (e.g., a CSRF token or a security-related flag).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the test account.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific non-session cookie name is identified from the application design or response headers.

steps.action: Log in to the portal with valid credentials.
steps.expected: The login is successful.

steps.action: Inspect the HTTP response headers for the 'Set-Cookie' field containing the identified non-session cookie.
steps.expected: The 'Set-Cookie' header is present for the non-session cookie.

steps.action: Check the attributes of the non-session cookie in the 'Set-Cookie' header.
steps.expected: The 'HttpOnly' attribute is present in the cookie definition.

test_cases.title: HSTS header is present on all responses with correct configuration
test_cases.preconditions: The VBP Software Design Document §14 specifies the maximum age and subdomain coverage for HSTS. The portal is accessible via HTTPS.
test_cases.test_inputs: URLs for various portal pages (e.g., login page, dashboard, static assets).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific max-age and includeSubDomains values are defined in VBP SDD §14.

steps.action: Send an HTTPS request to the portal's main page.
steps.expected: The response status is 200 OK.

steps.action: Inspect the response headers for the 'Strict-Transport-Security' field.
steps.expected: The 'Strict-Transport-Security' header is present.

steps.action: Verify the 'max-age' value in the HSTS header against the value defined in VBP SDD §14.
steps.expected: The 'max-age' value matches the specification in VBP SDD §14.

steps.action: Verify the 'includeSubDomains' directive in the HSTS header against the specification in VBP SDD §14.
steps.expected: The 'includeSubDomains' directive is present if required by VBP SDD §14.

steps.action: Send an HTTPS request to a different portal page (e.g., a static asset or API endpoint).
steps.expected: The response includes the 'Strict-Transport-Security' header with the same configuration.

test_cases.title: Valid file extension and content match
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated and has permission to upload files.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid PDF file with .pdf extension and correct PDF magic bytes.

steps.action: Upload a valid PDF file with a .pdf extension.
steps.expected: The system accepts the file and confirms the upload successfully.

test_cases.title: File extension mismatch with content
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated and has permission to upload files.
test_cases.test_inputs: A file with .jpg extension but containing PDF content (magic bytes indicate PDF).

steps.action: Upload a file with .jpg extension that contains PDF content.
steps.expected: The system rejects the file and displays an error message indicating a mismatch between file extension and content.

test_cases.title: Unsupported file extension
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated and has permission to upload files.
test_cases.test_inputs: A file with .exe extension.

steps.action: Upload a file with .exe extension.
steps.expected: The system rejects the file and displays an error message indicating that the file type is not allowed.

test_cases.title: Image within maximum pixel size
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated and has permission to upload images.
test_cases.test_inputs: An image with pixel dimensions below the maximum defined in VBP Software Design Document §14.
test_cases.assumptions: The maximum pixel size is defined in the VBP Software Design Document §14.

steps.action: Upload an image with pixel dimensions below the maximum allowed size.
steps.expected: The system accepts the image and confirms the upload successfully.

test_cases.title: Image exceeding maximum pixel size
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated and has permission to upload images.
test_cases.test_inputs: An image with pixel dimensions exceeding the maximum defined in VBP Software Design Document §14.
test_cases.assumptions: The maximum pixel size is defined in the VBP Software Design Document §14.

steps.action: Upload an image with pixel dimensions exceeding the maximum allowed size.
steps.expected: The system rejects the image and displays an error message indicating that the image size exceeds the maximum allowed dimensions.

test_cases.title: Failed sign-in response consistency for existing and non-existing users
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists in the system. A non-existing user identifier is known for testing.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid user identifier, invalid password. Non-existing user identifier, invalid password.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is accessible and network latency is stable enough to measure response times.

steps.action: Attempt sign-in with a valid user identifier and an incorrect password.
steps.expected: The system returns a generic error message (e.g., 'Invalid credentials') and an HTTP status code (e.g., 401 or 200 with error body). The response time is recorded.

steps.action: Attempt sign-in with a non-existing user identifier and an incorrect password.
steps.expected: The system returns the exact same generic error message and HTTP status code as in step 1. The response time is statistically indistinguishable from step 1 (within a small margin of error).

test_cases.title: Registration response consistency for existing and non-existing user identifiers
test_cases.preconditions: The registration endpoint is accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: A user identifier that already exists in the system. A user identifier that does not exist in the system.

steps.action: Submit a registration request with a user identifier that already exists.
steps.expected: The system returns a generic error message (e.g., 'Registration failed' or 'Invalid input') and a specific HTTP status code. The response time is recorded.

steps.action: Submit a registration request with a user identifier that does not exist.
steps.expected: The system returns the exact same generic error message and HTTP status code as in step 1. The response time is statistically indistinguishable from step 1.

test_cases.title: Forgotten-password response consistency for existing and non-existing users
test_cases.preconditions: The forgotten-password endpoint is accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid user identifier. A non-existing user identifier.

steps.action: Submit a forgotten-password request with a valid user identifier.
steps.expected: The system returns a generic success message (e.g., 'If the account exists, a reset link has been sent') and a specific HTTP status code (e.g., 200). The response time is recorded.

steps.action: Submit a forgotten-password request with a non-existing user identifier.
steps.expected: The system returns the exact same generic success message and HTTP status code as in step 1. The response time is statistically indistinguishable from step 1.

test_cases.title: Help Desk staff cannot set a specific password during reset initiation
test_cases.preconditions: A Help Desk staff account is logged in. A company representative account exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Company representative identifier. A specific password string (e.g., 'NewPass123!').
test_cases.assumptions: The Help Desk interface provides a field or API parameter for setting a password during reset initiation.

steps.action: Initiate the password reset process for the company representative and attempt to set the password to 'NewPass123!' via the interface or API.
steps.expected: The system rejects the attempt to set a specific password. The reset process is initiated without the staff member knowing the new password (e.g., a temporary link is generated or the user is notified to set their own password). The staff member does not receive the new password value.

test_cases.title: Help Desk staff can initiate password reset without choosing a password
test_cases.preconditions: A Help Desk staff account is logged in. A company representative account exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Company representative identifier.

steps.action: Initiate the password reset process for the company representative without providing a new password value.
steps.expected: The system successfully initiates the reset process. The representative receives a notification (e.g., email) with instructions to set a new password. The Help Desk staff member does not have access to the new password.

test_cases.title: New session token generation and old token invalidation upon re-authentication
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated with a valid session token (Token A).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for re-authentication.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows re-authentication while a session is active.

steps.action: Capture the current session token (Token A) and its validity status.
steps.expected: Token A is valid and associated with the user's active session.

steps.action: Perform re-authentication using valid credentials.
steps.expected: The system generates a new session token (Token B) and returns it to the client.

steps.action: Attempt to use Token A to access a protected resource.
steps.expected: The request is rejected with an authentication error, indicating Token A is no longer valid.

steps.action: Attempt to use Token B to access a protected resource.
steps.expected: The request is successful, confirming Token B is the active session token.

test_cases.title: Session token invalidation upon logout
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated with a valid session token.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid session token.

steps.action: Initiate the logout process using the active session token.
steps.expected: The system processes the logout request and confirms session termination.

steps.action: Attempt to use the same session token to access a protected resource.
steps.expected: The request is rejected, and the session is identified as invalid or terminated at the backend.

test_cases.title: Session token invalidation upon expiration
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated with a session token that has a defined expiration time.
test_cases.test_inputs: Session token with a short expiration time (e.g., 1 minute) or ability to manipulate system time.
test_cases.assumptions: The session expiration timeout is configurable or can be simulated for testing purposes.

steps.action: Wait for the session token to expire or advance system time past the expiration limit.
steps.expected: The session state is marked as expired in the backend.

steps.action: Attempt to use the expired session token to access a protected resource.
steps.expected: The request is rejected, and the session is identified as invalid or expired at the backend.

test_cases.title: Accessing own application data with valid identifier
test_cases.preconditions: User A is authenticated and has explicit permission to view Application X and Document Y.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid session token for User A, valid identifier for Document Y owned by User A.

steps.action: Send a request to retrieve Document Y using its valid identifier while authenticated as User A.
steps.expected: The system returns the content of Document Y successfully.

test_cases.title: Attempting to access another user's data by changing identifier
test_cases.preconditions: User A is authenticated. User B owns Document Z. User A does not have explicit permission for Document Z.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid session token for User A, valid identifier for Document Z owned by User B.

steps.action: Send a request to retrieve Document Z using its valid identifier while authenticated as User A.
steps.expected: The system denies access and returns an authorization error (e.g., 403 Forbidden). The content of Document Z is not exposed.

test_cases.title: Attempting to access non-existent data item
test_cases.preconditions: User A is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid session token for User A, an identifier that does not correspond to any existing document.

steps.action: Send a request to retrieve a document using a non-existent identifier while authenticated as User A.
steps.expected: The system returns a 'Not Found' error (e.g., 404) or a generic error message. No data is exposed.

test_cases.title: Bilgilendirici görsellerin metin alternatiflerinin doğrulanması
test_cases.preconditions: Portalda bilgilendirici görseller içeren bir sayfa (örneğin başvuru rehberi) yüklüdür.
test_cases.assumptions: Tarayıcıda ekran okuyucu veya DOM denetimi aracı kullanılabilir.

steps.action: Sayfadaki bilgilendirici bir görselin DOM yapısı incelenir.
steps.expected: Görsel öğesinin 'alt' özniteliği vardır ve içeriği görselin amacını açıklayan anlamlı bir metindir.

steps.expected: Ekran okuyucu, 'alt' özniteliğindeki metni seslendirir.

test_cases.title: Süsleme amaçlı görsellerin işaretlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Portalda süsleme amaçlı görseller içeren bir sayfa yüklüdür.

steps.action: Süsleme amaçlı bir görselin DOM yapısı incelenir.
steps.expected: Görsel öğesinin 'alt' özniteliği boş string ('') olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: Ekran okuyucu ile sayfa taranır.
steps.expected: Süsleme amaçlı görsel, ekran okuyucu tarafından atlanır ve seslendirilmez.

test_cases.title: Görsel düğmelerin erişilebilir adlarının doğrulanması
test_cases.preconditions: Portalda yalnızca görsel olarak sunulan bir düğme (örneğin 'Gönder' ikonu) vardır.

steps.action: Görsel düğmenin DOM yapısı incelenir.
steps.expected: Düğme öğesi, 'aria-label' veya 'title' gibi bir öznitelikle veya içine gömülü bir 'alt' metniyle erişilebilir bir ada sahiptir.

steps.action: Ekran okuyucu ile düğmeye odaklanılır.
steps.expected: Düğmenin işlevini açıklayan metin (örneğin 'Başvuruyu Gönder') seslendirilir.

test_cases.title: Tabloların programlı yapısının doğrulanması
test_cases.preconditions: Portalda veri tablosu içeren bir sayfa (örneğin başvuru durumu listesi) yüklüdür.

steps.expected: Tablo, '<table>', '<thead>', '<tbody>' ve hücreleri tanımlayan '<th>' (başlık) ile '<td>' (veri) öğelerini içerir.

test_cases.title: Başlık hiyerarşisinin programlı yapısının doğrulanması
test_cases.preconditions: Portalda çok başlıklı bir sayfa yüklüdür.

steps.action: Sayfanın DOM yapısındaki başlık öğeleri incelenir.
steps.expected: Başlıklar '<h1>' ila '<h6>' etiketleri ile işaretlenmiştir ve hiyerarşi sıralıdır (örneğin <h1>'den sonra <h3> gelmez).

steps.action: Ekran okuyucu ile başlık navigasyonu kullanılır.
steps.expected: Başlıklar hiyerarşik yapıda listelenir ve sayfa yapısı anlaşılır.

test_cases.title: Dikey ve yatay ekran yönlerinde içerik erişilebilirliği
test_cases.preconditions: Portalın bir sayfası açılmıştır.

steps.action: Ekran dikey (portrait) moda ayarlanır ve sayfa görüntülenir.

steps.expected: Tüm içerik ve işlevler erişilebilir ve kullanılabilir durumdadır; içerik kesilmez veya kaybolmaz.

test_cases.title: Form alanlarının autocomplete özniteliklerinin doğrulanması
test_cases.preconditions: Portalda kişisel bilgi toplayan bir form (örneğin kayıt formu) yüklüdür.

test_cases.title: Standart metin kontrast oranının doğrulanması
test_cases.preconditions: Portalın bir sayfası açılmıştır.

steps.expected: Tüm etkileşimli öğelere klavye ile erişilebilir ve odaklanılabilir.

test_cases.title: Sayfa başlığının varlığı ve içeriği

steps.action: Her sayfanın DOM yapısındaki '<title>' öğesi incelenir.
steps.expected: Her sayfada bir '<title>' öğesi vardır ve içeriği sayfanın konusunu veya amacını açıklayan anlamlı bir metindir.

steps.expected: Başlık, sayfanın içeriğini yansıtan doğru metni gösterir.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı metninin amacını açıklaması
test_cases.preconditions: Portalın bir sayfası açılmıştır.

steps.action: Sayfadaki bağlantıların metinleri incelenir.
steps.expected: Her bağlantının metni, bağlantının amacını veya hedefini açıkça belirtir (örneğin 'Başvuru Formunu İndir' yerine 'Buraya Tıkla').

steps.action: Ekran okuyucu ile bağlantılar listelenir.
steps.expected: Bağlantı listesi, her bağlantının amacını kullanıcıya net bir şekilde iletir.

test_cases.title: Klavye odak göstergesinin görünür olması
test_cases.preconditions: Portalın bir sayfası açılmıştır.

steps.action: Klavye 'Tab' tuşu ile etkileşimli bir öğeye (buton, bağlantı, form alanı) odaklanılır.
steps.expected: Odaklanan öğenin etrafında veya üzerinde, arka planla yeterli kontrast oranına sahip, görünür bir odak göstergesi (outline, border vb.) belirir.

steps.action: Farklı tipteki etkileşimli öğelere (buton, link, input) klavye ile odaklanılır.
steps.expected: Tüm etkileşimli öğelerde odak göstergesi tutarlı ve görünür şekilde çalışır.

steps.expected: 'lang' özniteliği 'tr' veya 'tr-TR' olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: İngilizce bir sayfanın '<html>' öğesinin 'lang' özniteliği incelenir.
steps.expected: 'lang' özniteliği 'en' veya 'en-GB'/'en-US' olarak tanımlanmıştır.

test_cases.title: Farklı dildeki bölümlerin dil işaretlemesi
test_cases.preconditions: İngilizce arayüzde Türkçe resmî belge adları içeren bir sayfa açılmıştır.

steps.expected: Türkçe metin parçaları, 'lang=
